title: Asymptotic Anytime-Valid Inference for U-statistics
summary: We study asymptotic anytime-valid confidence sequences for degree-two U-statistics under continuous monitoring. In the nondegenerate case, Hoeffding's projection reduces the problem to a time-uniform central limit theory for the partial sums of the first-order projection, while the canonical remainder is shown to be negligible under mild moment assumptions. A leave-one-out jackknife estimator then yields a fully data-driven procedure, leading to confidence sequences with asymptotic coverage guarantee for the parameter of interest.
